# Arabic "create" audit fixtures (21 Oct 2026)

PDFs written by Waraq's own engine writers (and a few prototypes of the fixes) for the audit in
`../../../../Archive-2026-10-12/reviews/ARABIC-CREATE-AUDIT-2026-10-21.md`. All are regenerated by `tools/arabic/gen-*.mjs`
(`editor.pdf` and `sign.pdf` are large and git-ignored). `manifest-<name>.json` lists, per page, the strings that were written
(logical order) so `tools/arabic/check.mjs <name>` can compare what MuPDF / pdf.js / Edge read back.
No customer files are used: every text is made up.
